cta.label: New to federal health IT capture?
cta.heading: Start with the primer.
cta.line: It walks the federal acquisition timeline and shows which MMT tool to reach for at each stage, from market shaping to proposal.

lifecycle.goal: Find opportunities before they go public, and help shape the requirement.
lifecycle.intel: Agency budgets, executive priorities, incumbent contracts, recompete forecasts.

lifecycle.goal: Signal capability to the program office and find teaming gaps.
lifecycle.intel: Incumbent performance, competitor capability, teaming partner data.

lifecycle.goal: Refine the win strategy and set pricing anchors.
lifecycle.intel: Historical pricing, labor categories, likely-bidder analysis.

lifecycle.goal: Make the Go or No-Go call and write a compliant response.
lifecycle.intel: RFP shred, compliance matrix (L, M, N), Go/No-Go decision.

lifecycle.goal: Earn the highest technical score you can.
Defend the win or learn from the loss for the next bid.

toolkit.name: Agency Profiles
toolkit.what: DHA, VA, and HHS budgets, programs, vehicles, and live procurement signals, each with a source URL and a visible last-updated date.
toolkit.how_to_use: Read the target agency's profile before you shape a pursuit.

toolkit.name: Org Charts
toolkit.what: The named people who own programs and sign decisions, auto-monitored so a leadership-page change triggers an alert.
toolkit.how_to_use: Find the program owner and who they report to before an industry day.

toolkit.name: IDIQ and Vehicle Tracker
toolkit.what: Vehicles with ceiling, period of performance, NAICS and PSC, set-aside, an incumbent-vulnerability score, and a forecast window with a confidence percentage.
toolkit.how_to_use: Check the vehicle's burn status and forecast window before committing capture hours.

toolkit.name: Signal Chain
toolkit.what: A five-layer monitor that scores a topic 0 to 100 from live federal APIs and emails you when the composite crosses 75.
toolkit.how_to_use: Set a monitor on your target program and act when it crosses the threshold.

toolkit.name: Pursuit Score
toolkit.what: Bid or no-bid support that scores a pursuit across four dimensions, including incumbent vulnerability, with a short analyst take.
toolkit.how_to_use: Run it at your Go/No-Go gate to pressure-test the decision.

toolkit.name: ProposalPulse
toolkit.what: Evaluator-style scoring on a draft plus SOW or PWS: a scorecard, top risks, and prioritized fixes in about 90 seconds.
toolkit.how_to_use: Score before red team, not after. First assessment is free.

toolkit.name: MarketPulse
toolkit.what: Ask a market question and get a source-cited pursuit brief in 24 hours.
toolkit.how_to_use: Use it when you need the answer synthesized, not the raw firehose. First brief is free.

toolkit.name: Ask MMT
toolkit.what: Question and answer over MMT's source-cited corpus of articles, briefs, contracts, and vehicles.
toolkit.how_to_use: Ask what MMT has published on a program before you research from scratch.

toolkit.name: Contract Tracker, Newswire, and Glossary
toolkit.what: Live contract movement with vendor, value, and NAICS, context notes, and a glossary that ties each term to its pursuit implication.
toolkit.how_to_use: Keep them open as your reference layer while you work a pursuit.

comparison.mmt: $199 a year; $0 to read the analysis; free tiers on the Pulse tools
comparison.legacy: GovWin about $12K to $14K per user a year, quote-only; GovSpend about $11.5K a year; Bloomberg Government about $7.5K to $14K

comparison.mmt: Auto-refreshed from live APIs, with a source URL and timestamp on each value
comparison.legacy: Analyst-refresh cycles (GovWin, Bloomberg Government) or the raw un-curated .gov firehose

comparison.mmt: Named, verified, source-cited, and auto-monitored; reorg leadership mapped within days
comparison.legacy: Often empty, stale, or a month behind on reorgs; small businesses cannot build their own

comparison.mmt: DHA, VA, HHS, and ONC health IT, with the why behind each buy
comparison.legacy: Broad federal and state generalists, thin on MHS and VA health IT context

comparison.mmt: Native: ProposalPulse, Pursuit Score, Signal Chain, and Ask MMT, plus connect-your-own agent
comparison.legacy: AI bolted on, or metered as a per-credit add-on

comparison.mmt: Public pricing; every claim carries a source link; no sponsors
comparison.legacy: Opaque, sales-led pricing and long reported time to value
